title: Meta Ordered to Pay $25 Billion Over Cambridge Analytica Scandal
excerpt: A New Mexico judge has ordered Meta to pay $25 billion in penalties for violating the state's unfair practices law in the Cambridge Analytica case.
body_html:
Meta has been ordered by a New Mexico judge to pay $25 billion in penalties following the Cambridge Analytica scandal. The financial penalty stems from over 43 million violations of the state's unfair practices law.

This ruling represents the largest legal financial hit that Meta has encountered during the year, adding to a series of other legal losses and challenges faced by the company.
